_comment: Stage 4I batch 3 - authorial rulings, 2026-09-01. Four inline records of the same typographic class and four different reasons for being in the text. Editorial axis only; provenance and rights verdicts are untouched.

entries.editorial_status: KEEP - KINSHIP. Tart names an epistemic limit the book independently holds; he is not required to certify it. Lead-in reframed from 'As Charles Tart aptly put it' to 'Charles Tart names the same limit:' - 'aptly' evaluated him as useful confirmation; the new frame establishes a relationship between two independently held positions.
entries.notes: Bibliography repair (MISSING) goes to Stage 7. Rights remains an open Stage 6 review - the fair-use conclusion is NOT pre-decided from quotation length.

entries.match: Life can only be understood backwards
entries.editorial_status: KEEP - ILLUMINATION. REFRAME with the mediated/evolved wording acknowledged. Lead-in changed from 'As Soren Kierkegaard said' to 'A familiar rendering of a thought Kierkegaard recorded in his journals puts it:' - the thought is in the journals (1843, IV A 164), but this compact English aphorism is not established as his exact wording.
entries.notes: Same shape as the Goethe ruling in batch 1: real ancestor, no single authoritative English sentence, so REFRAME rather than CORRECT - correction here would manufacture textual precision the evidence does not support. The frame distinguishes Kierkegaard's thought from this evolved English formulation without pretending to solve it. Identifying the translator/origin of this English form remains a provenance and rights task.

entries.match: it's all about one little word
entries.editorial_status: KEEP as written - PERSONAL COMMUNICATION / RELATIONAL VOICE. Not an authority entering the argument; a person entering the acknowledgments. The existing frame 'In your words' already names the object class in the prose. No change made.
entries.notes: No bibliography entry and no literary provenance chase. The one remaining task is confirming consent for publication, which is a Stage 6 item addressed to the author rather than to a rights holder.
